title: The Breach in the Wall
text: Something came up from the rift in the night and went back down again. It left a hole in the east wall wide enough for a cart.

temptation.label: Let the masons take your quarry's best stone home.
temptation.text: The foreman offers to look the other way on a few loads, for a share.

triumph.text: The breach is sealed stronger than before.

falters.text: The patch holds badly; things slip through on moonless nights.

calamity.text: The breach stands open. The next expedition must wait while the walls are manned.
